outcome.description: pr_opened when the change is delivered as a PR against the base branch — a newly created PR, or the canonical PR that already existed for this branch when your commits were pushed to it; no_change_needed when the codebase already satisfies the issue; needs_clarification when the issue is too ambiguous to proceed.

pr_url.description: URL of the opened pull request. Present when outcome is pr_opened.

pr_number.description: Number of the opened pull request, when the SCM exposes one. Optional even when outcome is pr_opened (pr_url is the stable identifier).

branch.description: The branch the PR was opened from. Present when outcome is pr_opened.

questions.description: The blocking questions a human must answer. Present and non-empty when outcome is needs_clarification.
